maintenance: PowerEvolve product fork: explicit English title and supplied bilingual metadata; see tests/test_compatibility.py. Original class, logo and specification retained. Numbered reviewed Markdown compatibility is covered by tests/test_numbered_headings.py; local image validation and real figure compilation are covered by tests/test_local_images.py and tests/test_local_images_compile.py.

changes.summary: Add opt-in portable typography using installed Noto CJK SC and TeX Gyre Termes faces without copying proprietary fonts; retain default template selection with explicit fallback diagnostics. Validate compact PDF names including the Noto SC collection's shared CFF aliases, required profile families, embedding/subsetting and the final compile log; reject missing glyphs, profile mismatches and compile/layout errors. Correct abstract body/keyword leading to an effective 18pt at 12pt type, retain source paragraphs and content, attach keywords to the preceding final line and allow normal continuation pages.

Separate labeled Markdown appendices from bibliography entries regardless of source placement, preserve source-link prose and URLs, emit the retained body/appendices/bibliography order and reject invalid or duplicate appendix labels. Preserve blank-line-separated bilingual abstract paragraphs, join continuous lines within each paragraph and escape prose before controlled TeX paragraph boundaries while retaining supplied word order and inline math.

Export validated local PNG, JPEG and PDF figures and convert static SVG through existing LibreOffice Draw; preserve authored figure numbering and a single caption, reject missing/invalid/external/escaping sources, copy compile-ready assets and disable TeX shell escape.

Read confirmed Arabic-numbered Markdown chapters alongside retained Chinese chapter forms, preserve heading numbers and hierarchy without duplicate numbering, and retain supplied abstracts, equations, references and tables.
